verdict.rationale: OpenClaw publishes a releases page with feature highlights, which works as a changelog, and has at least one migration page (Matrix migration). The pack has no evidence of explicit version numbering, a general upgrade guide with migration notes, or a repair or rollback path when an update breaks; the 'versioned state' mention is an architecture claim, not an update-rollback mechanism. Missing for 10: documented versioned release numbering, general update/upgrade migration notes, a repair or rollback procedure for failed updates, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, updating is safe and documented — versioned releases with changelogs, migration notes, and a repair or rollback path when an update breaks

citations.quote: Install supported plugins without restarting, set up teams of specialist agents, and use GPT Live in meetings and calls.
